params.body:
The staging site on naviskore.on-forge.com is being removed, and its address no longer resolves. Elixir measured it from `elixir.json` and kept reporting it as down, with a failed deploy.

This leaves production (naviskore.be) as the only environment Elixir watches. Nothing in the app reads this file.
params.title: Drop the staging environment from elixir.json
